title: Squared-profile difference bound
statement:
Let $a,b\in\bbr$ satisfy $b\ge0$, $a-b>0$, $a+b<1$, and $a\le\tfrac12$. With $Q$ the lower standard Gaussian quantile and $I(p)=\varphi(Q(p))$, one has
\[
\bigl(I(a+b)^2-I(a-b)^2\bigr)^2\le16I(a)^2Q(a)^2b^2.
\]
replaced: Let $\Phi$ and $\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and put $Q=\Phi^{-1}$ and $I(p)=\varphi(Q(p))$ for $0<p<1$. If $b\ge0$, $a-b>0$, $a+b<1$, and $a\le1/2$, then $(I(a+b)^2-I(a-b)^2)^2\le16I(a)^2Q(a)^2b^2$.
